hints.qqSwitch.triggers.idle_topic: Start a topic after the conversation has been quiet for the configured interval.

hints.qqSwitch.rhythm.initiative_queue_o: Keep one pending opportunity when the scheduling window reaches its upper bound while busy.
hints.qqSwitch.rhythm.initiative_time_wi: Allow elapsed time to trigger proactive evaluation as well as the message-count window.
hints.qqSwitch.reply.split_by_speaker: Reply separately to authorized speakers rather than once for the entire conversation.
